document.abstract: An automatic programming device depends on automatic gain control in typical TV applications. An “All Electronic” AGC with sufficient operational range for use as an integral part of a monochrome vidicon film center is described and compared to other gain-control methods. An automatic programmer also lends itself to the switching functions of a color film center using the flying-spot-scanner principle.
